sourceDatesPolicy: Null dates are unknown. URL folders, filename years, crawler dates and access dates are not invented publication dates.

sources.title: Vienna Tourist Board public transport tickets
sources.evidence: Adult single EUR 3.20; 24-hour EUR 10.20; non-transferable digital seven-day EUR 25.20; paper seven-day EUR 28.90. Core-zone coverage excludes the airport leg.
sources.limitation: Use the digital seven-day product as a planning choice, not the cheapest option for every short stay.

sources.title: Cafe Prueckel published menu
sources.evidence: EUR: Viennese breakfast 9.80; cappuccino 4.90; cheese toast 8.90; beef goulash with dumplings 19.80; 0.5-litre soda 3.80. Menu states VAT included.
sources.limitation: 2026-labelled file; exact issue date is not printed. One cafe basket, not a city average; no dietary suitability promise.

sources.title: Vienna tourism tax statute section 14
sources.evidence: Tourism tax is 5% of the statutory assessment base during this period.
sources.limitation: Do not add 5% indiscriminately to an already gross room quote; the assessment base is defined separately.

sources.title: City of Vienna tourism tax calculation guidance
sources.evidence: Official indexed guidance describes the base as accommodation excluding VAT and breakfast.
sources.access: Official search extract available; direct page retrieval failed.
sources.limitation: Reopen the official calculation guidance before normalizing any room quotation.

sources.title: Upper Belvedere visitor information
sources.evidence: Official indexed visitor information lists current-day adult admission EUR 23 and free admission under 19; Lower Belvedere is a separate venue.
sources.access: Official indexed page extract; direct retrieval timed out.
sources.limitation: Reconfirm directly for publication. This is not a November time-slot quotation and is excluded from profile proposals.

sources.title: TfL adult caps and Travelcard prices 2026
sources.evidence: 2026 adult Zones 1-2 daily PAYG cap GBP 8.90; Southeastern high-speed and Heathrow Express excluded.
sources.limitation: Requires correct payment use. Airport trips and zones outside 1-2 are not covered by this allowance.

sources.title: MD3517 July 2026 fare decision
sources.evidence: Bus/tram fare freeze ends 1 November 2026; other rail fares not specifically corrected remain unchanged.
sources.limitation: Do not reuse the earlier GBP 5.25 bus-only cap for November travel.

sources.title: Dishoom Covent Garden breakfast menu
sources.evidence: GBP: date/banana porridge 9.50; house chai 4.90. Published optional service charge 12.5%.
sources.limitation: Menu issue date not printed; illustrative cafe breakfast.

sources.title: Dishoom Covent Garden all-day menu
sources.evidence: GBP: paneer roll 12.90; chole puri halwa 15.90; fresh nimbu soda 5.90. Optional service charge 12.5%.
sources.limitation: One venue and dining style, not a budget minimum or London market average.

sources.title: HMRC VAT in public price lists
sources.evidence: Public consumer price lists include applicable VAT.
sources.limitation: Do not add VAT a second time to the published London menu basket.

sources.title: Westminster Abbey opening times and prices
sources.evidence: Current page: adult GBP 32; one-adult/one-child family GBP 32; child 6-17 GBP 14.
sources.limitation: Selected-date opening and sightseeing restrictions apply; no universal per-person charge should replace family conditions.

sources.title: UK government overnight visitor levy announcement
sources.evidence: Government announcement concerns local powers to introduce a percentage levy.
sources.limitation: Does not establish an operative London rate or start date. Do not enter either a speculative levy or a confirmed zero.

sources.title: RATP one-day Navigo pass
sources.evidence: EUR 12.30 per calendar day for Zones 1-5; airport access excluded; compatible smartphone loading supported.
sources.limitation: Assume a compatible phone. Physical card purchase and airport tickets are not included.

sources.title: Cafe de Flore public menu
sources.evidence: EUR: croissant 4.00; espresso 5.50. Menu states taxes and service included.
sources.limitation: 2025-path PDF with no verified current effective date; currency/price observation only. Reconfirm a current menu before profile inclusion.

sources.title: Bouillon Chartier indicative menu
sources.evidence: Indicative menu: main courses EUR 7-13.80; desserts EUR 2-4.90.
sources.limitation: Menu explicitly changes daily. Upper range bounds do not establish prices for particular dishes or future dates.

sources.title: French consumer authority restaurant guidance
sources.evidence: Displayed restaurant prices include applicable taxes/service; a meal customer can request free tap water.
sources.limitation: Extra drinks and optional gratuities are outside the provisional Paris basket.

sources.title: Service Public Paris 2026 tourist tax table
sources.evidence: Paris two-star tourist tax EUR 3.25; three-star EUR 5.53, per adult per night including listed additions.
sources.limitation: Not a flat charge for all accommodation or all travellers; use actual classification and guest eligibility.

sources.title: Louvre ticket prices
sources.evidence: Adult EEA resident/citizen rate EUR 22; non-EEA non-resident/non-citizen rate EUR 32; under-18 and other exemptions apply.
sources.limitation: Current page, not a reserved slot. No age or residency is collected by GoEksplo; do not assume the EUR 22 rate worldwide.

sources.title: MTA subway and bus fares
sources.evidence: Subway/local bus base fare USD 3; seven-day cap USD 35 using the same payment medium. Express bus USD 7.25.
sources.limitation: Two paid rides per day are an assumption, not unlimited travel. Airport services are outside the proposed allowance.

sources.title: Pershing Square breakfast menu
sources.evidence: USD: oatmeal 18; coffee 6.
sources.limitation: One Midtown sit-down venue; no city-wide representativeness or current meal availability established.

sources.title: Pershing Square lunch menu
sources.evidence: USD: beef burger with fries or salad 24. Linked PDF states 20% gratuity for parties of five or more.
sources.limitation: Need current service-charge terms across all meals and party sizes before publishing a daily food allowance.

sources.title: Pershing Square dinner menu
sources.evidence: Current HTML lists pasta primavera USD 24.
sources.limitation: No exact menu effective date; excludes drinks beyond breakfast coffee. Do not substitute an older downloadable price for the observed HTML price.

sources.title: NYC311 sales tax
sources.evidence: Combined city/state/MCTD sales tax is 8.875%.
sources.limitation: Apply only to taxable items and charges; no second tax on an already inclusive quotation.

sources.title: New York restaurant sales and gratuities guidance
sources.evidence: Restaurant meals generally taxable. Voluntary tips are not taxed; mandatory gratuity tax treatment depends on stated conditions.
sources.limitation: A conservative taxed service buffer is a planning assumption, not a statement of the actual restaurant bill.

sources.title: NYC hotel room occupancy tax
sources.evidence: For room rent USD 40 or more, flat city component USD 2 per room/day; state hotel unit fee USD 1.50 per unit/day.
sources.limitation: Suites can have more than one taxable room; do not apply the ordinary single-room formula universally.

sources.title: NYC311 hotel occupancy tax rate
sources.evidence: City hotel occupancy rate 5.875% remains in effect.
sources.limitation: Together with ordinary 8.875% sales tax gives 14.75%, subject to taxable-base and exemption rules.

sources.title: The Met visitor admission
sources.evidence: General adult admission USD 30; children 12 and under free; eligible residents/students have different payment rules.
sources.limitation: One admission is not the price of an entire itinerary or a per-night activity charge.

sources.title: Pod 39 official FAQ
sources.evidence: Facility fee USD 29.84 inclusive of tax per room/night in addition to room rate.
sources.limitation: Not a room quote; verify the booking total includes this fee before adding anything separately.

accommodationInspection.reason: Public property information does not supply a complete dated rate, tax total and cancellation terms.

accommodationInspection.roomCandidate: Standard Room with a double bed, maximum two people
accommodationInspection.reason: Booking controls require date/occupancy selection; retrieved page defaults to one adult and supplies no qualifying total.

accommodationInspection.roomCandidate: Queen Pod, sleeps two, private bathroom
accommodationInspection.reason: Room identity verified; dynamic booking rate and cancellation terms not captured; published facility fee cannot supply missing base price.
